extraction.Name: Alma A. Sauser, formerly Alma A. Wells
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent in fee and accepted it under protest because she was told that if she did not accept it and keep up the taxes that the land would be sold to satisfy them
extraction.Recorded patent: recorded in the office of the Register of Deeds of Jackson County, South Dakota, April 29, 1919 in Book C of patents on page 87 thereof
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: mortgaged to the Farmers State Bank of Kadoka, South Dakota, for approximately $2500.00 sometime during the year 1919; mortgage foreclosed sometime during the year 1922 and she has lost her land
extraction.Buyer: Farmers State Bank of Kadoka, South Dakota (foreclosed mortgage of approximately $2500.00)
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: could not raise the money to keep up the taxes on said land so that said land was mortgaged; could not pay the mortgage so it was foreclosed
extraction.Occupation/Income: has no special training to carry on any employment sufficiently remunerative to support said children and if employment is sought must necessarily perform tasks of labor for which the compensation is slight and insufficient to support said children
extraction.NOTES: Patent # 825388; land described as Southwest quarter (SW4) of section twelve (12) Township forty-three (43) Range thirty-six (36) West of the 6th P.M., South Dakota; land valued at approximately $5000.00 at time of mortgage; affiant states she was not actually defrauded but money received was less than 50% of real worth after paying taxes and other debts; affiant states she has been damaged to the extent of $5000.00; mentally competent, health is just fair; has no land and lives with her children; has five minor children dependent upon her for support; has received no aid from the Government, State or County since fee patent was issued; most of mortgage proceeds used to pay debts not contracted before patent was issued; affidavit sworn January 23, 1929, State of Nebraska, County of Cedar | ORIGINAL_TRIBE_VALUE: "Pine Ridge Sioux Reservation" (normalized 2026-04-28 to canonical 'Pine Ridge')

recovery_notes.rationale: Pine Ridge tribe field had 40+ string variants across the corpus. Consolidating to canonical 'Pine Ridge' for clean tabulation while preserving original variant in NOTES for audit.
